title: Optimal Transport Aggregation for Distributed Mixture-of-Experts
abstract: arXiv:2312.09877v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper considers the setting in which local Mixture-of-experts (MoE) models are fitted independently on distributed datasets and must be combined into a single global MoE model. Weighted averaging the local mixtures, whose experts are not aligned across machines, often yields a large mixture with many experts instead of $K$ and does not provide an estimator of the true model parameters. We propose to reduce this large mixture to a $K$-expert MoE by minimizing an expected transportation divergence, in which the transport plan depends on the covariates. A relaxation of this problem separates the experts from the gating network: the experts are computed by a majorization--minimization algorithm, which decreases the objective monotonically, and the gating network is then fitted to the gates implied by the optimal plan, with an explicit bound on the resulting loss. translated_title: 面向分布式混合专家模型的最优传输聚合
translated_abstract: 本文考虑这样一种场景：在分布式数据集上独立拟合本地的混合专家模型，然后需要将这些模型合并为单一的全局MoE模型。由于各机器上的专家并未相互对齐，对本地混合模型进行加权平均通常会产生一个包含大量专家（而非K个专家）的大型混合模型，并且无法提供真实模型参数的估计。我们提出通过最小化一个期望传输散度，将该大型混合模型缩减为具有K个专家的MoE模型，其中传输计划依赖于协变量。该问题的一个松弛形式将专家与门控网络解耦：专家通过主化-最小化算法计算得到，该算法使目标函数单调下降；随后将门控网络拟合到由最优传输计划所隐含的门控上，并给出了由此产生损失的显式上界。我们证明，只要满足一定条件，聚合估计量就具有一致性。
tldr: 提出一种基于最优传输散度的聚合方法，可将分布式环境中独立训练的多个本地混合专家模型合并为一个一致且仅含K个专家的全局MoE模型。
en_tdlr: Proposes an optimal-transport-based aggregation method that combines independently trained local mixture-of-experts models from distributed settings into a consistent global MoE model with exactly K experts.
